integrity: Exact Laurent-polynomial proof provided; packaged finite checks are supplemental rather than evidence for infinite quantifiers. No independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Odd primes and r>=1 only; excludes p=2, other index families, and higher normalized p-adic residues. Potential earlier unindexed equivalent results remain a literature risk.
title: A prime-power divisibility law for Riordan numbers with a unique five-adic resonance
